query:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?) expected
            LEFT JOIN memory_records m ON m.bear_id = ?
                AND m.memory_id = json_extract(expected.value, '$[0]')
            WHERE m.memory_id IS NULL OR m.content_text IS NOT json_extract(expected.value, '$[1]')
        ) AS "matches!: bool"
